figures.finding: Grenada gives creative practitioners and businesses registered with the Grenada Office of Creative Affairs, film and television among them, 100% concessions on the Common External Tariff and VAT on equipment and tools of trade (S.R.&O. 11 and 13 of 2023, in effect from 1 March 2023); no production rebate was found.

value.law: S.R.&O. 11 of 2023 Customs (Duties Exemptions) Order; S.R.&O. 13 of 2023 VAT Order

figures.applies: Grenada; registered creative practitioners and organisations.

sources.said: can apply for 100% concessions on Common External Tariff (CET) and Value Added Tax (VAT) on equipment and tools of trade. … According to S.R.&O. 11 of 2023 Customs (Duties Exemptions) Order and S.R. &O. 13 of 2023 Value Added Tax (Amendment of Third and Fourth Schedules) (No. 2) Order … fashion, film, games and toys, music, publishing, research and development, software, television and radio

figures.finding: Grenada's Cultural and Creative Industries Business Development Fund, run by the Grenada Development Bank, offers creative businesses low-interest loans up to 50,000, grants up to 25,000 for non-profit cultural initiatives and business support vouchers up to 5,000 (currency not stated on the page; Grenada uses the East Caribbean dollar), having contributed over 2.7 million since launch.
